key_insight: The models describe tornado development as convectively driven rotating flow, with angular-momentum conservation intensifying rotation and peak azimuthal velocity occurring in the tornado wall.
engineering_relevance: These idealized flow models may support interpretation of tornado wind structure relevant to wind-hazard engineering.
method: Associate tornado initiation with Schwarzschild convective instability.
Develop simplest, refined, and full models using stream function, azimuthal velocity, and density evolution.
Construct an analytical solution from eight heightwise linear dependencies and examine single-vortex and two-eyed configurations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports analytical and model-based flow behavior but provides no observational validation, experimental comparison, or quantitative accuracy metrics.
watch_item: Ideal-hydrodynamic assumptions and boundary-condition-sensitive differential rotation limit direct application to real tornadoes.
paper_title: Some generalizations of the tornado model
